levels.title: The First Flow: Raw Materials and Logistics
levels.primary_learning_objective: Production starts with reliable material supply.
levels.player_fantasy: I have a factory, but can I get the materials moving?
levels.starting_situation: The plant has a basic production route, but raw-material handling is incomplete or inefficient.
levels.completion_criterion: The player can explain why reliable upstream supply matters to downstream production.

quests.title: First Arrival
quests.situation: A cargo ship is arriving at the berth with the plant's first raw-material cargo. Nothing has unloaded yet; the yard is empty.
quests.goal: Receive the first cargo ship and get raw material into the yard.

options.label: Initiate/confirm the basic unloading route (berth -> yard)

decision.note: No trade-off yet — this quest teaches the flow, not a choice. One action: confirm the route.

quests.consequence: The ship's hold visibly empties tonne by tonne; the first stockpile appears in the yard and the HUD yard-stock number starts climbing.
quests.learning_takeaway: Material must enter the plant before production can consume it.

conditions.note: three 1,000 t cargo ships landed in the yard (SME-settled by Yasser, F-12 retune pass)

scoring_tiers.silver: unloaded without blocking the berth queue
scoring_tiers.gold: unloaded with the yard route confirmed before arrival

quests.title: Keep It Moving
quests.situation: Material is in the yard, but movement into storage is restricted — unloading stalls while the yard still has room (unload_blocked_t climbs: the handling link, not the stock, is limiting).
quests.goal: Identify the restricted link and choose a simple flow improvement.

options.label: Increase the unload rate (handling equipment upgrade)
Reorganize the yard layout to open more receiving space

decision.note: Both are simple first-level options; the cheaper one teaches that flow fixes are not always purchases.

quests.consequence: unload_blocked_t stops climbing, ship holds empty faster, berth queue shortens and demurrage pressure eases.
quests.learning_takeaway: Material handling can limit production even when stock exists.

conditions.note: no unload blocked over the final stretch (placeholder band)

quests.title: Feed the Furnace
quests.situation: The EAF needs a sufficient scrap supply to start its production cycle; incoming arrivals alone do not cover the furnace's consumption if the yard buffer runs thin.
quests.goal: Keep the furnace fed for a full production cycle by prioritizing replenishment of the yard buffer.

options.label: Prioritize unloading of the arrivals that feed the furnace stockpile
Build the yard buffer above target before starting the furnace cycle

decision.note: Supply-plan priority, not machine control — the player plans the flow (visible-not-micromanaged transport ruling, gameplay.md §8).

quests.consequence: yard stock stays above the furnace feed line; production runs without starvation gaps (upstream_blocked_t stays low).

conditions.note: starvation kept under one day of production draw (placeholder band)

scoring_tiers.silver: cycle completed with buffer never below target
scoring_tiers.gold: completed without a single restricted tick

quests.title: First Steel
quests.situation: Arrivals keep coming on a fixed cadence while the furnace keeps consuming. The supply route must stay balanced across a full run — overloading one side blocks the other.
quests.goal: Restore a stable material flow and complete the first production milestone: the plant's first steel produced from a balanced flow.

options.label: Adjust operating hours so arrivals, unloading and furnace draw match over the run
Grow the yard buffer as a cushion against arrival jitter

decision.note: No single right answer — both strategies work; scoring rewards low congestion.

quests.consequence: First Steel milestone fires: stockpile, furnace cycle and dispatch all move together on screen; congestion_flag stays down.
quests.learning_takeaway: The plant is a connected flow, not a collection of isolated machines.

scoring_tiers.gold: milestone with ledger tidy AND zero demurrage

optional_challenges.title: No Idle Furnace
optional_challenges.situation: Same Level 1 run, stricter terms: meet the production target while minimizing avoidable raw-material starvation.
optional_challenges.goal: Meet the production target with minimal upstream_blocked_t.

options.label: Tighten the arrival/unload/consume balance to near-zero blocked tonnage

optional_challenges.consequence: Starvation counter visibly drops toward zero; a clean-flow badge appears on the plant.
optional_challenges.learning_takeaway: Avoidable starvation is an operational choice, not bad luck.

scoring_tiers.gold: target met with zero blocked tonnage
